metadata.scope: exact reduction of the exactly-one correction to a scalar primitive face-cuboid height count; no overlap asymptotic is proved

notation.O_ab_ac: primitive canonical cuboids with ab and ac face diagonals integral
notation.O_ab_bc: primitive canonical cuboids with ab and bc face diagonals integral
notation.O_ac_bc: primitive canonical cuboids with ac and bc face diagonals integral
notation.T: primitive canonical cuboids with all three face diagonals integral (perfect-cuboid overlap locus)

single_scalar_reduction.F_definition: number of primitive canonical integer face cuboids with d<=B, i.e. integer edges and space diagonal and at least two integral face diagonals
single_scalar_reduction.histogram_identity: if E2=exactly-two count and E3=triple count, then F=E2+E3 and O=E2+3E3
single_scalar_reduction.consequence: the sufficient bound implies every overlap correction is o(B(log B)^3), hence N_q(B)~A_q(B) categorywise
single_scalar_reduction.triple_note: No separate bound for T is needed once F (or O) is lower order; T<=F. In particular no assumption about nonexistence of perfect cuboids is used.

projective_face_cuboid_bridge.normalization: divide a primitive integer overlap by d; this gives a rational face-cuboid similarity class with two rational face diagonals and rational space diagonal
projective_face_cuboid_bridge.inverse: clear denominators of a rational face cuboid and divide the common gcd to recover a primitive integer representative
projective_face_cuboid_bridge.interpretation: F(B) is therefore a rational-point height-count problem on the face-cuboid locus, not a local-density perturbation of the Stage12 Euler product

elliptic_surface_literature_bridge.reference: Takumi Yoshida, The relationship between face cuboids and elliptic curves, arXiv:2407.09825 (2024)
elliptic_surface_literature_bridge.published_structural_result: a surjective 32:1 map from pairs (s,P), with P a non-torsion rational point on E_{1,s}, to rational face-cuboid equivalence classes
elliptic_surface_literature_bridge.use_here: this identifies the correct arithmetic-geometric object and shows the overlap locus is genuinely infinite; it does not supply the uniform height-count bound required here

required_new_theorem.stronger_convenient_form: F(B)=O(B(log B)^(3-delta)) for some delta>0, or any O(B^(1-epsilon)) bound
required_new_theorem.elliptic_form: obtain a height-uniform count for the relevant rational points across the family E_{1,s}, after translating elliptic height to the primitive cuboid space-diagonal height

raw_limit_waiting_for_transfer.conditional_exact_one_statement: if F(B)=o(B(log B)^3), then the exact-one normalized limit equals the raw/Stage13-3b chamber limit
